results.title: Summertime Sadness
results.overview: A woman's quarter life crisis is exacerbated by the sweltering summer heat.

results.title: Good Help
results.overview: Between 2023 and 2024, nearly 40,000 Venezuelan migrants were bused from Texas to Denver, Colorado. After traveling more than 3,000 treacherous miles on foot - many with young children in tow - they found themselves living on Denver’s streets in the middle of winter, without housing or legal permission to work.

results.title: Yagoat
results.overview: The story follows Yaqoot, an ambitious young Kuwaiti man who dreams of becoming a successful lawyer. However, his laziness and limited intelligence land him in serious trouble from his very first day at court, when he becomes entangled with a dangerous gang leader.  His life takes a dramatic turn when his grandmother gives him a mysterious drink that boosts his confidence, launching him into a journey filled with comedic situations and high-stakes confrontations, where he transforms from a desperate underdog into an unexpected hero.  A journey from failure to confidence… and from weakness to strength.

results.title: Time to the Target
results.overview: While Ukraine is fighting, how does it affect the rear? For a year and a half, Vitaly Mansky has portrayed his hometown of Lviv, where everyone’s existence is shaped by the Russian missiles’ flight time to their targets.

results.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
results.original_title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 19, 2026, at Chino Cultural Complex in Chino, Nagano, Japan.

results.title: Stalin Boys
results.overview: Four Mexican-American middle school boys in a Texas border town have developed an unusual obsession: Joseph Stalin. When their teacher tells them about the Texas State History Fair, they write a play about the Soviet dictator and his efforts to destroy all who opposed him. With cardboard props and fur hats purchased on the internet, the boys enter the competition as underdogs and leave home for the very first time.

results.title: I Problematici, ovvero: un amico e un'amica
results.original_title: I Problematici, ovvero: un amico e un'amica
results.overview: He is engaged to his best friend. He and she are great friends, and they love each other very much. One day he will be kicked out of the house by her friend, and it will be she who will host him to sleep, with all the consequences of the case.

results.title: Stickball: The Little Brother of War
results.original_title: Stickball: The Little Brother of War
results.overview: A ragtag women's team of underdogs and outsiders must come together to defeat the incumbent champions, earn ancestral pride for their community, and settle a historic rivalry in the oldest and bloodiest sport in America: Native American Stickball.

results.title: 93 'Til
results.overview: A struggling artist painter on the brink of eviction and a vintage curator haunted by inherited dreams skip the corporate future they're supposed to want and spend one day discovering whether love is worth the risk.

results.title: Whispering Trees
results.overview: Yascha Krüger is a shy forestry official who struggles with dating and tends to scare people off. While temporarily working in a forest district, he meets Mats, a photographer, and the two develop a romantic connection. At the same time, Yascha is assigned a professional task: to persuade the heirs of a recently deceased landowner to sell a private forest so it can be turned into a national park. As Yascha becomes more involved in both his work and his growing feelings for Mats, he finds himself telling lies that complicate his relationships and force him to confront what he truly wants—both personally and professionally.

results.title: Knotted
results.overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after failing to land a job post-graduation, only to be thrown into a serving job at her past acquaintance's wedding.

results.title: Bury Us in a Lone Desert
results.overview: When a burglary takes an awkward turn, a young thief encounters an old man seeking a fatal reunion with his wife. Following the perspective of the thief, we witness his journey of emotions: from getting caught up in an absurd situation to growing a kin-like bond to the old man before fulfilling his final wish. Through this implausible journey, love unfolds with genuine simplicity and a bittersweet ending.

results.title: Bad Romance
results.overview: A man returns to Lagos with a wealthy fiancée and a plan to steal her fortune. His family welcomes her, but their smiles hide a con. As the facade cracks, hidden identities and jealousies turn the home into a pressure cooker of deception.

results.title: Somnus
results.overview: A young boy wakes up in a nightmarish experiment.

results.title: Informal Crooks
results.overview: After the failed robbery of a bail bond store in '95 Los Angeles, a sharp detective interrogates four participants who each provide their version of events.

results.title: National Theatre at Home: Summerfolk
results.overview: It's a hot, beautiful summer in 1905, and Russia's elite retreat to the countryside to swim, sip champagne and start affairs. When they're having this much fun, why care about anything else? But Varvara just can't shake the feeling that their holiday idyll is built on borrowed time. As the party continues, how long can they ignore the storm on the horizon? Deputy Artistic Director Robert Hastie (Standing at the Sky's Edge) directs Maxim Gorky's razor-sharp portrait of class, privilege and denial, revived for 2026 in a new adaptation from Nina Raine (Consent) and Moses Raine (Donkey Heart).

results.title: Buried Under Years of Dust
results.overview: Emily Grodin is an autistic woman who spoke minimally for a significant part of her life, until she had a breakthrough and began to express herself in new ways.
